newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's TAM airline hires new director.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's TAM airline hires new director.

text.p: Brazil's TAM airline named Rubel Thomas deputy director to the president, O Globo newspaper said Friday.
Thomas is a former president of Brazilian air carrier Varig.
TAM officials were not immediately available to comment on the report.
Thomas will take responsibility for managing TAM's international flights between Brazil and other countries in the Mercosur trade bloc, the newspaper said.
Mercosur is comprised of Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay. Chile recently became an associate member.
Thomas will also take charge of new international service to Europe and the United States from Brazil, O Globo said.
